data.name: Chakravarti
data.gender_notes: Chakravarti is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chakravarti is recorded with the meaning “Universal Monarch”. Chakravarti is a Sanskrit name meaning “Universal Monarch”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chakravarti expresses “Universal Monarch”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: चक्रवर्ती
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one whose chariot (or wheel) revolves around the entire world.

in_hindi.name: चक्रवर्ती
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who rules over the entire universe.

in_tamil.name: சக்ரவர்த்தி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who rules over all the worlds (jeykum jeykattin arasar)

in_telugu.name: చక్రవర్టి
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who rules over all the worlds (jeyyamoddu jeyyadhuddu eswar)

in_marathi.name: Chakravarti
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chakravarti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over the entire universe.

in_bengali.name: Chakravarti
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Universal Monarch
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chakravarti একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over the entire universe.
